# Christian Henao (Artag) — Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer

> Bilingual (EN / ES) engineering portfolio and architecture lab for Christian Henao (Artag), based in Pereira, Colombia. Focuses on applied AI systems: multi-channel agents, pgvector RAG pipelines, semantic LLM caching, and event-driven backends with human oversight.

## Primary Pages

- [Home (English)](https://www.artagdev.com.co/): Value proposition, interactive pipeline simulator (Atiende RAG & CV Harness), skills, featured systems, testimonials, and contact form.
- [Inicio (Español)](https://www.artagdev.com.co/es): Versión en español del portafolio principal y simulador interactivo de pipelines.
- [Engineering Lab](https://www.artagdev.com.co/labs): Interactive architecture board, I/O contracts, circuit breaker patterns, audited test metrics, 13-microservice private org map (`artag-services`), infrastructure, and certifications.
- [Laboratorio de Arquitectura (Español)](https://www.artagdev.com.co/es/labs): Tablero interactivo de arquitectura, harnesses, infraestructura y estudios en español.
- [About Me — The Architect's Ledger](https://www.artagdev.com.co/about-me): Chronological developer journey (2006–2024) and personal background.
- [Sobre Mí (Español)](https://www.artagdev.com.co/es/about-me): Cronología completa de trayectoria y perfil personal en español.

## AI Systems & Case Studies

- [All Projects](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects): Complete index of shipped systems and engineering case studies.
- [Atiende — Multi-Channel AI Agent](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects/atiende): WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and Messenger AI agent with pgvector RAG, semantic caching (~30% LLM cost reduction), BullMQ queues, and human escalation (295 tests across 40 files).
- [CV Harness — Event-Driven Job Search](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects/cv-harness): 7-stage idempotent pipeline with structured parsing, semantic matching, deterministic scoring, and strict Zod output validation (188 API tests, 17/17 E2E tests).
- [Social Harness — Human-Guided AI Coach](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects/social-harness): Human-in-the-loop content coaching workflow with explicit approval gates and rubric scoring.
- [Doc Harness — Structured AI Document Editing](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects/doc-harness): Scoped AST diff patching engine for deterministic document edits.
- [WhatsApp Operations Platform](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects/whatsapp-operations-platform): Operational messaging and workflow automation platform.
- [Artag Dev Portfolio](https://www.artagdev.com.co/projects/artag-portfolio): Bilingual Next.js 15 portfolio with interactive architecture lab and live gaming API integrations.

## Engineering Notes

- [Engineering Notes Index](https://www.artagdev.com.co/engineering-notes): Technical write-ups on applied AI systems, caching, and architecture trade-offs.
- [Exact and semantic caching for LLMs (~30% cost reduction)](https://www.artagdev.com.co/engineering-notes/llm-semantic-cache-cost-reduction): Layered prompt, exact, and semantic caching architecture to cut LLM conversation costs.
- [Architecture of a WhatsApp AI agent with RAG and human escalation](https://www.artagdev.com.co/engineering-notes/whatsapp-ai-agent-architecture): Webhook verification, Redis deduplication, BullMQ queues, pgvector retrieval, and dashboard handoff.
